description: Check a used car by its 17-character VIN (vehicle identification number). Returns the car's make and model as decoded by Carlytics, plus a link to the free result page where the buyer can unlock the full vehicle history report (mileage records, inspection history, damage records where available, stolen-vehicle check, recalls, valuation). Use it whenever the user shares a VIN or asks whether a specific used car is OK to buy. Always show the user the report link.

language.description: The user's language or market code for the result page, e.g. 'de' for German, 'pl' for Polish, 'us' for the United States. Omit if unsure.

vin.description: The 17-character VIN, as the user wrote it. Spaces and lowercase are fine.

name: check_vin
title: Check a car by VIN
